node.title: Hex value of Perl file handle to uniquely identify
node.author: eyepopslikeamosquito
node.doctext:
To compare and report on file handles stored in various data structures, I'd like to uniquely identify a Perl file handle. I noticed that running: open my $fh, '<', $0 or die "error: open '$0': $!"; my $fh_hex = sprintf '0x%x', $fh; printf "fh='$fh' fh_hex='$fh_hex'\n"; produces: fh='GLOB(0x202068)' fh_hex='0x202068'

So I suppose I could use $fh_hex above as a string that uniquely identifies a file handle. Is there a better way?
